title: Poisson boundaries of type III factors and the relative bicentralizer conjecture
summary: We develop the Poisson boundary theory for general von Neumann algebras with separable preduals. As applications, we generalize and give new proofs of the results on the weak Dixmier property for inclusions with expectations or operator-valued weights \cite{Pop99,Mar19,Iso25}. We also prove that every continuous factor admits irreducible embeddings into the hyperfinite factors of type $\mathrm{III}_\lambda$, $0<\lambda\leq1$, and into some hyperfinite factor of type $\mathrm{III}_0$.
